name: Plaid
description: Plaid financial data API for bank account linking, balances, identity, transactions and payments.
auth_notes: client_id and secret sent in the request body or in PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET headers; access_token per Item.
gate_detail: Sandbox is always free with test Items. Production access must be requested via the Dashboard; a free Trial (US/Canada, new teams) allows 10 Production Items; EU/UK customers only get Custom plans.
api_scope: Endpoints and webhooks across products such as Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions, Investments, Liabilities and Enrich; Node SDK shown.
mcp_notes: Plaid-hosted remote Dashboard MCP server with diagnostics and analytics tools; URL not stated in sources.
blocker_detail: Production API access must be requested via the Dashboard; Growth/Custom plans and EU/UK use require contacting sales.

evidence.quote: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a `client_id` and `secret`.
You can [request Production API access](https://dashboard.plaid.com/overview/production) via the Dashboard.
Free Trial plans are available to new Plaid teams (US/Canada only) created on or after April 15, 2026.
If your business is based in the EU or UK, or serves end users there, only Custom plans are available.
API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Auth product.
The **Dashboard MCP server** is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid.

issues: MCP server URL is not stated in the sources.
Whether Production request approval is discretionary is not detailed.
Dashboard MCP uses OAuth tokens for Dashboard tools, not the core API.
